issues.description:
Method return type mismatch for PersonService.savePerson(Person):
- Template (expected) declares public Person savePerson(Person person) and returns the saved or updated Person instance.
- Solution repository's service declares public void savePerson(Person person) (no return value).
- Solution repository's PersonResource.createPerson(...) (line with ResponseEntity.ok(personService.savePerson(person))) calls personService.savePerson(...) and expects a Person return value to wrap in ResponseEntity.ok(...).
This mismatch (void vs Person) will cause a compilation error in the solution (the controller expects a returned Person) and contradicts the template and the problem statement guidance to not change PersonService attributes, blocking the REST endpoints from functioning.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore a consistent method signature: change PersonService.savePerson(Person) in the solution repository to return Person (public Person savePerson(Person person)) and return the newly created or updated Person instance. Update the method body to return the created Person when adding and the updated Person when modifying. This keeps the controller's ResponseEntity.ok(personService.savePerson(...)) calls valid and aligns with the template and problem statement.
